verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents multiple concrete mechanisms for persistent, team-level memory: natural-language 'learnings' that teach review preferences (coderabbit-docs-7), auto-detected guideline files like CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md applied as review criteria (coderabbit-docs-10), path- and AST-based instructions (coderabbit-docs-8, coderabbit-docs-9), and org-wide central configuration repos (coderabbit-docs-14) that persist across future PRs. Community feedback broadly corroborates useful, context-aware reviews (coderabbit-comm-1, coderabbit-comm-6) though some found it verbose/low-value (coderabbit-comm-2), which is general sentiment rather than a concrete contradiction of the memory feature itself. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that learnings specifically persist and get applied correctly across multiple future PRs over time, rather than just first-party doc claims.
